relations.text_en: Agreed to buy its operating assets

source.label: UFP Industries 8-K(2026年10月)
source.quote: On October 26, 2026, UFP Industries, Inc. issued a press release announcing its entry into an agreement to acquire the operating assets of Apache Products, Inc., a wood pallet manufacturer headquartered in Silsbee, Texas.
